description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/vessel-mitosis-evaluate.ts, make the baseline test suite run in a structurally identical overlay to the patched suite, so that overlay artifacts cancel out of the introduced-failure delta instead of being blamed on the patch.

THE DEFECT: the patched suite runs in a symlink overlay built by buildOverlay (line 625: `runRoot = await buildOverlay(baseRootForOverlay, mitosisRoot, stagedFiles);`) while the baseline suite runs directly against the real base tree. Any test whose result depends on the tree's physical shape therefore differs between the two runs for reasons unrelated to the diff, and the delta reports it as INTRODUCED BY THE PATCH. Measured three times today on repos/activity-api/src/routes/execution-traces.ts: src/routes/trace-key-agreement.test.ts Glob-scans its sibling tree and asserts `expect(sources.length).toBeGreaterThan(50)` (its own comment: "guards the scan itself"); in the overlay, non-test sources are symlinks and Bun's Glob.scan does not traverse symlinks (measured: 1 visible .ts versus 212 via `find -L`), so the corpus is empty and the guard fires. On the real base tree the same test passes, so the delta calls it new. Each of the three patches was independently verified correct — clean `bun run typecheck` and 4 pass / 0 fail for that very test — on a clean copy of the vessel.

MAKE TWO EDITS, both anchored on strings verified to occur exactly once in this file.

EDIT 1 — build a baseline overlay of the same shape. The exact line
          const cached = baselineSuiteCache.get(baseForDelta);
occurs once. Immediately BEFORE that line, construct an overlay for the baseline that has the SAME staged relative paths but BASE content, by passing baseForDelta as both the base and the mitosis root:
          const baseOverlayRoot = await buildOverlay(baseForDelta, baseForDelta, stagedFiles);
Because buildOverlay copies each staged file from its second argument, passing baseForDelta there yields an overlay identical in structure to the patched one and identical in content to the base tree.

EDIT 2 — run the baseline in it. The exact line
          : await runCheck(bunCmd, ["test"], baseForDelta, "bun test (baseline)", SUITE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS);
occurs once. Replace the third argument `baseForDelta` with `baseOverlayRoot`, leaving the rest of the line byte-identical.

ALSO: the cache at line ~180, `const baselineSuiteCache = new Map<...>()`, is keyed by base root alone. Since the baseline result now depends on the staged-file shape too, include that shape in the key — use `baseForDelta + "|" + [...stagedFiles].sort().join(",")` as the key in BOTH the `.get(...)` and the `.set(...)` call so a cached baseline from a differently-shaped overlay cannot be reused.

Do NOT change buildOverlay itself. Do NOT change the patched-side call at line 625. Do NOT change the failure-name parsing, the truncation guard, or the fail-closed branches — those are correct and each guards a real past regression documented in the surrounding comments.

CONSEQUENCE THIS ENABLES: patches to repos/activity-api/src/routes/execution-traces.ts stop being refused with "1 failure(s) INTRODUCED by this patch: trace boundary — the write and read agree on key names". That vessel is currently un-landable through the autonomous path for this reason; two correct fixes had to be landed by an operator today instead.
